def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Solver, sat
    rb_node = Int('rb_node')
    cie_tmp = Int('cie_tmp')
    s = Solver()
    s.add(rb_node != 0)
    s.add(cie_tmp == 0)
    s.add(cie_tmp != 0)
    return s.check() == sat
